# Keep the Light 1.25.0

- **TMDB: match one episode, and the rest of the show follows.** When the queue's TMDB lookup can't tell which show you mean (there are several called *The Office*), open one episode with Edit, choose the right show and save. Every other waiting episode is then filled in from that show, each with its own title, date, description and season poster. Your choice is remembered, so next season's files match without asking. You can forget remembered matches in ⚙ Settings. Lookups are also faster: each show is searched once, not once per episode.
